message: Designer is checking the furniture layout

I explored a restrained, cozy scheme with soft upholstery and warm neutrals, but the catalog checker couldn’t produce a complete compatible living-and-dining set; chair compatibility remains unresolved.

I inspected three chair renders: the “felt grey” chair appears cream, so I rejected that palette match. No purchases were selected or changes applied. Your budget remains unconfirmed; I won’t present an incomplete set as a finished remake.
